insurer: Star Health and Allied Insurance Company Limited

good.name: Room Rent
good.quote: Room (Single Private A/c Room), Boarding and Nursing Expenses as provided by the Hospital / Nursing Home.
good.reference: Section 2 (Coverage) - Section 1(A) and Section 2(A); Schedule of Benefits (Page 9/10) 'In-patient Hospitalization Single Private AC Room'
good.explanation: The policy covers a single private AC room during hospitalization, which is the industry standard. This ensures you have a comfortable private room without additional room rent restrictions.

good.name: Initial Waiting Period
good.quote: 30-day waiting period - Code Excl 03 (Applicable for Section 1) ... Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident
good.explanation: Illnesses are excluded for the first 30 days from policy start, but accidents are covered immediately. This means you cannot claim for illnesses diagnosed within the first month.

good.name: PED Waiting Period
good.quote: Applicable for Section 1: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing Disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy with insurer
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are excluded for 36 months from policy start. Claims for these conditions are payable only after three continuous years of coverage.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting
good.quote: Specified disease / procedure waiting period - Code Excl 02 (Applicable for Section 1) ... shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy
good.reference: Exclusions - 2. Specified disease / procedure waiting period - Code Excl 02
good.explanation: Certain specified illnesses and procedures have a 24-month waiting period. Claims for these conditions are payable only after two years of continuous coverage.

good.name: Restore Benefit
good.quote: There shall be automatic restoration of the Basic Sum Insured once by 100% upon exhaustion of the limit of coverage during the policy period. It is made clear that such restored Sum Insured can be utilized only for illness / disease unrelated to the illness / diseases for which claim/s was / were made.
good.reference: Special Features - 3(a) Automatic Restoration of Basic Sum Insured
good.explanation: The sum insured is restored once per policy year but only for unrelated illnesses. This gives extra coverage once if the base sum insured is fully used, but not for the same illness.

good.name: No Claim Bonus
good.quote: The insured person will be eligible for Cumulative bonus calculated at 10% of basic sum insured for each claim free year subject to a maximum of 100% of the basic sum insured.
good.reference: Special Features - 3(b) Cumulative Bonus; Schedule of Benefits (Page 9/10) 'No Claim Bonus 10% for every claim free year maximum up to 100%'
good.explanation: You earn a 10% bonus on the sum insured for every claim-free year, up to 100%. However, this bonus may reduce after a claim as it is not protected.

bad.name: Consumables
bad.quote: Such associated medical expenses do not include Cost of pharmacy and consumables, Cost of implants and medical devices and Cost of diagnostics.
bad.explanation: Consumables like gloves, syringes, and pharmacy costs are not covered explicitly. You may have to pay out-of-pocket for these items during hospitalization.

bad.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
bad.quote: Pre-hospitalization Expenses: Medical expenses incurred up to 30 days immediately before the insured person is hospitalized.
bad.reference: Coverage - Section 1(E) and Section 2(E); Schedule of Benefits 'Pre & Post Hospitalization Expenses 30 days & 60 days'
bad.explanation: Pre-hospitalization expenses are covered only for 30 days, which is on the lower side. This may increase your out-of-pocket costs for tests and consultations before admission.

bad.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
bad.quote: Post Hospitalization Expenses: Medical expenses incurred up to 60 days immediately after the insured person is discharged from the hospital.
bad.reference: Coverage - Section 1(F) and Section 2(F); Schedule of Benefits 'Pre & Post Hospitalization Expenses 30 days & 60 days'
bad.explanation: Post-hospitalization expenses are covered for 60 days, which is less than some plans offering longer coverage. This may limit coverage for follow-up treatments.

bad.name: Disease Sub-limits
bad.quote: Basic Sum Insured (Rs.) Limit for Cataract Surgery (Rs.) 5,00,000/- 30,000/- per eye and not exceeding 40,000/- per policy period ... 7,50,000/-, 10,00,000/- and 15,00,000/- 40,000/- per eye and not exceeding 60,000/- per policy period
bad.reference: Coverage - Section 1(H); Schedule of Benefits (Page 9/10) 'Cataract Limit...'
bad.explanation: There is a specific sub-limit for cataract surgery capped at ₹40,000–₹60,000 depending on sum insured. You may pay extra if surgery costs exceed these limits.

bad.name: Modern Treatments
bad.quote: Coverage for Modern Treatments ... is limited to the amount mentioned in table below. This benefit forms part of sum insured. *Sublimits all inclusive with or without hospitalization...
bad.reference: Coverage - Section 1(J) / Section 2(J) reference (Modern Treatments section appears under Section 1 with applicability to both Section 1 and 2); Schedule of Benefits 'Modern Treatments Covered (up to the sub-limits)'
bad.explanation: Modern treatments are covered but subject to sub-limits within the sum insured. This can reduce effective coverage for expensive advanced procedures.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: No explicit co-payment clause found in the provided pages for hospitalization claims.
bad.reference: Policy Wording pages provided (1/10 to 10/10) - Co-pay not stated
bad.explanation: The policy does not clearly state if a co-pay applies or not. This is important as co-pay affects claim payouts, so clarification is needed from the full policy.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
